objections.claim: CI previously validated review artifacts without proving that a review covered the latest substantive implementation state.
objections.evidence: The validator now requires a passing review whose implementation revision is an ancestor of HEAD and rejects coverage when any later path is outside a top-level reviews/*.json artifact. CI checks out full history and invokes the gate on every configured push and pull request.
objections.disposition: Resolved. Deterministic tests cover allowed review-only follow-up, substantive code after review, non-ancestor reviews, nonpassing reviews, and nested nonartifact paths.

objections.claim: The gate is intentionally conservative if the pull request base branch advances after review, because the synthetic merge commit can contain base changes not present in the reviewed implementation revision.
objections.evidence: Coverage is computed by diffing the reviewed revision directly against the checked-out CI head. This can create a false negative after unrelated base-branch movement, but it cannot create a false positive for unreviewed feature changes.
objections.disposition: Accept for now because failing closed is preferable for the research harness. If it becomes operationally noisy, compare against the PR head revision while separately validating base ancestry.
